name: La Frecuencia Kirlian
s: In the midnight hour, a lone DJ broadcasts the strangest - and scariest - tales from the outer edges of Kirlian, a lost city somewhere in Argentina.

paragraphs.text: The Kirlian Frequency (also known as La Frecuencia Kirlian or Ghost Radio) is an Argentine animated webseries released in 2017 on YouTube and Vimeo and, on 15 February 2019, the first five episodes were exclusively available on Netflix. The series revolves around a radio that broadcasts only at night, in a small town deep inside Buenos Aires Province where all kinds of macabre and supernatural events occur.
